registered_after: target-assisted diagnostic and target-blind local32 feasibility probe only
registered_before: all held32 and fresh32 candidate construction or scoring
candidate: one post-tail rigid component translation from relation votes
control: exact frozen confirmed six-arm fusion final layout
component_definition: components of focal-kept selected-supply edges already realised by the control layout; singleton components are ineligible
relation_hypotheses: each cross-component selected-supply directed edge proposes the unique endpoint-component translation that would realise it
relation_score: sum softplus(focal_logit), then vote support, then lower all-bond cost as deterministic tie breaks
move: translate exactly one nontrivial component and row-major relocate only directly displaced tiles into vacated cells
objective_guard: candidate original TASKA all-1104-bond raw seam cost must be strictly lower than control
fallback: return control bit-for-bit when no eligible improving hypothesis exists
